# Doppler

Doppler is a secrets management platform that helps developers organize and sync environment variables across teams and infrastructure.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/doppler/.

## Actions

- **Download Secrets** (read-only): Download secrets from a Doppler config in various formats.
- **Get Authenticated User Info** (read-only): Retrieve information about the authenticated user or token.
- **Get Config** (read-only): Retrieve a specific Doppler config by project and config name.
- **Get Project Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific Doppler project by its identifier.
- **Get Secret** (read-only): Retrieve a specific secret from a Doppler project config.
- **List Doppler Configs** (read-only): List configurations from a Doppler project.
- **List Doppler Projects** (read-only): List all Doppler projects in your workspace.
- **List Doppler Secrets** (read-only): List all secrets for a specific Doppler config within a project.
- **List Environments** (read-only): List all environments in a Doppler project.
- **List Secret Names** (read-only): Retrieve the list of secret names from a specific Doppler config.
- **Update Doppler Secrets**: Update secrets in a Doppler config.
- **Create Encrypted Share Link**: Generate a Doppler Share link by sending an encrypted secret.
- **Create Plain Text Share Link**: Generate a Doppler Share link by sending a plain text secret.
- **Delete Secret**: Delete a secret from a Doppler config.
- **Get Config Log** (read-only): Retrieve a specific config log from Doppler.
- **Get Project Role** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific project role in Doppler.
- **Get Workplace Information** (read-only): Retrieve workplace information from Doppler.
- **Get Workplace Role** (read-only): Retrieve workplace role information from Doppler.
- **List Change Requests** (read-only): List existing change requests in the Doppler workplace.
- **List Config Logs** (read-only): Retrieve configuration change logs for a specific config in a project.
- **List Integrations** (read-only): Retrieve all existing integrations in Doppler.
- **List Project Role Permissions** (read-only): List all available permissions for project roles in Doppler.
- **List Project Roles** (read-only): List all available project roles in Doppler.
- **List Workplace Permissions** (read-only): Retrieve all available workplace permissions in Doppler.
- **List Workplace Roles** (read-only): List all workplace roles in your Doppler workspace.
- **Update Secret Note**: Update a note for a secret in Doppler.
